notes.title: NOISZ STΔRLIVHT comes to iOS and Android on 2/2!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=UMXrwLRQaxU;full][/previewyoutube]

Looking forward to the continuation of Grace, Sera, Sumire, and Hakuno's story? You've seen the prologue... now get ready for NOISZ STΔRLIVHT, coming to iOS and Android in just 2 weeks!

Preorder now (it's free):
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/noisz-starlivht/id1582334373
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.AnarchEntertainment.NOISZSTARLIVHT

We hope you'll join us again for this new adventure!

notes.title: 2ECONDS TO STΔRLIVHT: My Heart's Reflection released!
notes.content:
The second entry in the 2ECONDS prequel series to the upcoming NOISZ STΔRLIVHT has been released! Click below and check out this free VN, a short story about a transgender girl trying to find friends and a place to belong.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1479030/2ECONDS_TO_STRLIVHT_My_Hearts_Reflection/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30522987/ed721a6e3cef3cb461b8d9d0bdb1ce4bf5b24731.jpg[/img][/url]

As of this posting, the game that started it all, the original NOISZ is playable for free, so if you haven't played it and enjoyed 2ECONDS, you won't want to miss out on this!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/681530/NOISZ/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38565742/5476c432ac96548913a19000e2ba31373f12a109.jpg[/img][/url]

There's lots more exciting things coming for the NOISZ series this year, so keep an eye out!

notes.title: v1.1: Now with Achievements
notes.content:
Forever My Diamond now supports Steam Achievements! There's fittingly a total of 2, one for each ending. (Did you know the game has two endings? Well, now you do!)

It's also a little bit easier to get Grace's ending than before, so don't fret if you weren't able to find it.

(In some cases, previous save data may be incompatible, in which case you'll have to start a new game. It's only about an hour long, so hopefully it doesn't cause you too much trouble.)
